answer_1.quote: The fill-in-the-blanks setting requires the prediction of context-aware antonyms by capturing the contrasting features between the word pair. The task also requires a consideration of the naturalness of a text when filling the blank, which is necessary for applications of generating text with antonyms.

answer_2.quote: We used top-1 and top-10 accuracy values as the measures for the correctness of model predictions.

answer_4.quote: To investigate such cases with multiple possible correct words, we conducted a subjective evaluation of the quality of the answers of the human subjects and the proposed method (with the participation of another human subject).
answer_4.guideline: We chose an answer from three subjects at random for each instance because we had multiple answers from three subjects. Table  reports the number of predictions from the human subjects and the proposed method for which the manual evaluation recognized contrastiveness and naturalness (fluency).
